comparison.objective: Balance a rolling cylinder on a lifted board for ten seconds; candidate tunes shock absorption across repeated impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous bimanual tilt correction from moving-load feedback versus hex-key use, collar adjustment, counterholding, relocking, and discrete cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Board held for 10 seconds with no drop, roller loss, or robot contact versus two bounded, repeatable stops without hard-stop strike, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Both use feedback from dynamic behavior, but one tests continuous balancing while the other tests mechanical parameter adjustment and retention.
